name: tabs
label: Tabs
description: A segmented tab control for switching between panels of content. Compose with <x-tabs.list>, <x-tabs.tab> and <x-tabs.panel>.

props.name: default
props.description: The tab key to select initially. Defaults to the first tab.

slots.name: slot
slots.default: <x-components.tabs.list><x-components.tabs.tab tab="account">Account</x-components.tabs.tab><x-components.tabs.tab tab="billing">Billing</x-components.tabs.tab></x-components.tabs.list><x-components.tabs.panel tab="account">Manage your account details here.</x-components.tabs.panel><x-components.tabs.panel tab="billing">Manage your plan and payment details here.</x-components.tabs.panel>

usage: Match each <x-tabs.tab tab="key"> to an <x-tabs.panel tab="key">. The first tab is selected automatically.
